sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举办的 Dealbook 峰会上，现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: In the weeks since China imposed a strict new security law on Hong Kong, dozens of people have been arrested there.
sentences.zh: 自中国在香港实施新的严厉安全法以来的几周内，当地已有数十人被捕。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Austin Ramsey, speaks to the most high-profile figure arrested so far about his quest for freedom and the future of Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事奥斯汀·拉姆齐将采访迄今为止被捕的最受瞩目的人物，探讨他对于自由的追求以及香港的未来。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, September 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月3日，星期四。

sentences.en: Austin, who exactly is Jimmy Lai?
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀，黎智英究竟是谁？

sentences.en: Jimmy Lai is a wealthy media tycoon in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 黎智英是香港一位富有的媒体大亨。

sentences.en: Jimmy Lai has lived the Hong Kong dream.
sentences.zh: 黎智英活出了“香港梦”。

sentences.en: He went from rags to riches.
sentences.zh: 他白手起家，成就了财富。

sentences.en: He went from working in a Hong Kong sweatshop to founding a business empire that is now worth around $1 billion.
sentences.zh: 他从香港一家血汗工厂的工人，一路打拼，创立了一个如今价值约10亿美元的商业帝国。

sentences.en: He made his first fortune in clothing.
sentences.zh: 他的第一桶金来自服装业。

sentences.en: He's now in media.
sentences.zh: 他现在投身于媒体行业。

sentences.en: Lai is the owner of Apple Daily, one of the most widely read newspapers in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 黎智英是《苹果日报》的老板，这是香港阅读量最大的报纸之一。

sentences.en: He's a man about town.
sentences.zh: 他是一位活跃于社交圈的人物。

sentences.en: He's politically active.
sentences.zh: 他在政治上非常活跃。

sentences.en: Mr. Lai is Hong Kong's most prominent pro-democracy campaigner.
sentences.zh: 黎先生是香港最著名的民主运动人士。

sentences.en: He's an outspoken critic of Beijing's policies in the territory.
sentences.zh: 他是北京方面在港政策的直言不讳的批评者。

sentences.en: Outspoken, unafraid, he has said, to cause trouble, to speak his mind and to support his publication.
sentences.zh: 他直言不讳、无所畏惧，曾表示自己不怕惹麻烦，要坚持表达自己的想法并支持他的出版物。

sentences.en: And the story of how he became who he is is very much a story of Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 他如何成为今天的他，这个故事在很大程度上就是香港的故事。

sentences.en: He reflects, in many ways, the promise of Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 他在许多方面反映了香港的希望。

sentences.en: And now what's happening to him today reflects some of the disappointments.
sentences.zh: 而他今天所经历的一切，也反映出了一些令人失望的现实。

sentences.en: Police in Hong Kong have arrested media mogul and democracy proponent Jimmy Lai, along with six other people, under that controversial new national security law.
sentences.zh: 香港警方根据那部充满争议的新国家安全法，逮捕了媒体大亨、民主派人士黎智英以及其他六人。

sentences.en: After the national security law was passed, Jimmy Lai was arrested.
sentences.zh: 国家安全法通过后，黎智英被捕了。

sentences.en: And after he was held for about a day, he was released and out on bail.
sentences.zh: 在被拘留约一天后，他获准保释出狱。

sentences.en: And he agreed to talk to us.
sentences.zh: 他同意接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: So, one morning, my colleague Tiffany May and I
sentences.zh: 于是，一天早上，我和我的同事蒂芙尼·梅

sentences.en: went and visited him at his house.
sentences.zh: 去他家里拜访了他。

sentences.en: It's in a neighborhood of old colonial houses on the Kowloon Peninsula.
sentences.zh: 他的家位于九龙半岛的一片老殖民风格建筑区。

sentences.en: And by American standards, it's a large suburban house.
sentences.zh: 按照美国的标准，这是一栋大型郊区住宅。

sentences.en: But by Hong Kong standards, where people have a couple hundred square feet to themselves at most, it's enormous, and there's a gate.
sentences.zh: 但按照香港的标准——那里的人们最多只有几百平方英尺的私人空间——这栋房子非常巨大，而且还有大门。

sentences.en: Oh, we can go in now.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们现在可以进去了。

sentences.en: This guard said.
sentences.zh: 这位保安说道。

sentences.en: Hello, welcome back side.
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎回来。

sentences.en: And a new Mercedes outside.
sentences.zh: 外面停着一辆崭新的奔驰车。

sentences.en: There are five cars parked here.
sentences.zh: 这里停了五辆车。

sentences.en: And we walk into his house.
sentences.zh: 我们走进他的房子。

sentences.en: We're being led into a living room with a grand piano, many oil paintings.
sentences.zh: 我们被带进了一个摆放着三角钢琴和许多油画的客厅。

sentences.en: There's lots of art on the walls, stacks of books, fresh flowers, and we wait to meet him for breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 墙上挂满了艺术品，堆着书，放着鲜花，我们等待着与他共进早餐。

sentences.en: He's saying that during the interview, we could wear the mask on the wall or something.
sentences.zh: 他说采访期间，我们可以戴上墙上的口罩之类的东西。

sentences.en: Hopefully not while we're eating.
sentences.zh: 希望吃东西的时候不用戴。

sentences.en: And so, Jimmy Lai comes in after his morning workout.
sentences.zh: 黎智英晨练后走了进来。

sentences.en: Yeah, have some coffee and breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 来，喝点咖啡，吃点早餐。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He's wearing sort of a multi-millionaire casual with some gray sweatpants and a seersucker jacket and a white dress shirt.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一身千万富翁式的休闲装，灰色运动裤，泡泡纱夹克，还有一件白色衬衫。

sentences.en: And so, we sit down at a table.
sentences.zh: 我们在一张桌子旁坐下。

sentences.en: It's sort of an enclosed veranda next to his backyard.
sentences.zh: 那是一个靠近他后院的封闭式阳台。

sentences.en: Cheers.
sentences.zh: 干杯。

sentences.en: Cheers.
sentences.zh: 干杯。

sentences.en: Cheers.
sentences.zh: 干杯。

sentences.en: And we start talking.
sentences.zh: 我们开始交谈。

sentences.en: Well, maybe if we could start, you know, wherever.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也许我们可以从……随便哪里开始。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: You just ask.
sentences.zh: 你尽管问。

sentences.en: Ask away.
sentences.zh: 随便问。

sentences.en: If I can't answer, I'll tell you why I can't answer.
sentences.zh: 如果我不能回答，我会告诉你原因。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: And where does Jimmy Lai's story start?
sentences.zh: 黎智英的故事是从哪里开始的呢？

sentences.en: Where do you begin this conversation?
sentences.zh: 这段对话该从哪里切入？

sentences.en: So, Jimmy Lai was born in Canton.
sentences.zh: 黎智英出生在广东。

sentences.en: It's now known as Guangzhou in mainland China.
sentences.zh: 也就是现在中国大陆的广州。

sentences.en: He's born in 1948, just before the communist takeover of China in 1949.
sentences.zh: 他出生于1948年，就在1949年共产党接管中国之前。

sentences.en: And this is a very wrenching and difficult period for a lot of people, including Jimmy Lai's family.
sentences.zh: 对于很多人来说，包括黎智英的家人，那是一个非常痛苦和艰难的时期。

sentences.en: There's campaigns to take land and property from the wealthy.
sentences.zh: 当时有没收富人土地和财产的运动。

sentences.en: What did your family do in mainland China?
sentences.zh: 你的家人在中国大陆是做什么的？

sentences.en: My family was a shipping business.
sentences.zh: 我的家族经营航运生意。

sentences.en: You know, my family were quite rich.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的家人相当富有。

sentences.en: That's why we became the enemy of the people.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们成了“人民的敌人”。

sentences.en: So, you know, the whole family was marginalized.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，整个家庭都被边缘化了。

sentences.en: And by the time he's a young boy, there's a mass collectivization campaign called the Great Leap Forward.
sentences.zh: 当他还是个小男孩时，发生了一场名为“大跃进”的大规模集体化运动。

sentences.en: And it results in widespread starvation.
sentences.zh: 这导致了大规模的饥荒。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, that was a very difficult time in mainland China.
sentences.zh: 那是中国大陆一段非常艰难的时期。

sentences.en: Because famine.
sentences.zh: 因为饥荒。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: You have some food, but sometimes you're hungry.
sentences.zh: 你有食物，但有时还是会饿。

sentences.en: You have to eat vegetable, rice, or whatever.
sentences.zh: 你不得不吃蔬菜、米饭或者其他什么东西。

sentences.en: And contributes to a famine in which tens of millions of people are believed to have died.
sentences.zh: 这导致了一场据信有数千万人死亡的饥荒。

sentences.en: And so, while he lives in Canton, which is a, comparatively, a relatively well-off place in China, it's still quite difficult for him and his family.
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然他住在广东——相比之下，那是中国一个相对富裕的地方——但对他和他的家人来说，生活依然非常艰难。

sentences.en: Well, I work as a boy luggage carrier in a railway station in Canton.
sentences.zh: 我小时候在广东火车站当过行李搬运工。

sentences.en: He told us that he was working at a railway station as a porter.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，他曾在火车站当搬运工。

sentences.en: And that's where he sort of first got the inspiration to go to Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那里，他第一次萌生了去香港的想法。

sentences.en: So, I had access to people who came from Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 我当时有机会接触到从香港来的人。

sentences.en: Those guys I carried the baggage for.
sentences.zh: 就是那些我帮他们搬行李的人。

sentences.en: But one day I carried a baggage for a guy who was biting a bar of chocolate.
sentences.zh: 有一天，我帮一个正在咬巧克力棒的人搬行李。

sentences.en: And he gave me a tip.
sentences.zh: 他给了我一点小费。

sentences.en: And he gave the dark chocolate to me also.
sentences.zh: 他还把黑巧克力也给了我。

sentences.en: That he, you know, he ate almost half of it.
sentences.zh: 他自己吃了一半左右。

sentences.en: And I was shy.
sentences.zh: 我当时很害羞。

sentences.en: You know, I turned around and I bite it.
sentences.zh: 我转过身，咬了一口。

sentences.en: I said, wow.
sentences.zh: 我说，哇。

sentences.en: What's this?
sentences.zh: 这是什么？

sentences.en: It's a chocolate.
sentences.zh: 这是巧克力。

sentences.en: I said, where are you from?
sentences.zh: 我说，你是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 香港。

sentences.en: I said, Hong Kong must be heaven.
sentences.zh: 我说，香港一定是天堂。

sentences.en: And so, he tried it and he was amazed.
sentences.zh: 他尝了一口，感到非常惊讶。

sentences.en: And at that moment he said, I have to get to this place.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，他说，我一定要去那个地方。

sentences.en: So, for this poor young man, wherever that chocolate came from, he wanted to be.
sentences.zh: 所以，对于这个贫穷的年轻人来说，无论那块巧克力来自哪里，他都想去那里。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it becomes clear in talking to him that food is a very big consideration.
sentences.zh: 在与他交谈中可以清楚地感觉到，食物是一个非常重要的考量因素。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a period of starvation in China.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是中国饥荒的时期。

sentences.en: Then I told my mother, I have to go.
sentences.zh: 然后我告诉母亲，我必须走。

sentences.en: My mother said, you know, you go to Hong Kong, it's like going to the moon.
sentences.zh: 我母亲说，去香港就像去月球一样。

sentences.en: I will never see you again.
sentences.zh: 我再也见不到你了。

sentences.en: It's very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 这太危险了。

sentences.en: And his parents are, you know, reluctant to allow him to go.
sentences.zh: 他的父母当时并不愿意让他走。

sentences.en: He's quite young.
sentences.zh: 他还很小。

sentences.en: He's 12.
sentences.zh: 他才12岁。

sentences.en: But he tells us that his mother also realized that there was a real risk of him starving.
sentences.zh: 但他告诉我们，他的母亲也意识到，他确实有饿死的风险。

sentences.en: My mom actually allowed me to go just because, you know, you stay here and maybe you would die from famine.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈其实是允许我走的，因为如果你留在这里，可能会死于饥荒。

sentences.en: And I left and smugged under the fishing boat from Macau to Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 我离开了，藏在从澳门到香港的渔船下面。

sentences.en: And from Macau, he makes his way onto a fishing boat and he's smuggled by a fishing boat into Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 从澳门出发，他设法上了一艘渔船，并被偷渡到了香港。

sentences.en: And the same night I arrived, I was taken to a factory as a boy worker.
sentences.zh: 我到达的那天晚上，就被带到一家工厂当童工。

sentences.en: The factory manager told those other kids to take me in the morning to breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 工厂经理告诉其他孩子，第二天早上带我去吃早餐。

sentences.en: And the first time I saw so much food.
sentences.zh: 那是我第一次见到这么多食物。

sentences.en: It's the first time I realized food is actually freedom when you have a choice of food.
sentences.zh: 那是我第一次意识到，当你能选择食物时，食物实际上就是自由。

sentences.en: I was so emotional about food that when the food was served and I ate the first bite, I stood up to eat it.
sentences.zh: 我对食物感触太深了，以至于上菜时，我吃第一口的时候，竟然站了起来。

sentences.en: I don't know why.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么。

sentences.en: You know, it's just like paying respect to food.
sentences.zh: 就像是对食物表示敬意一样。

sentences.en: And I was poor, but I never felt I was poor because I was so hopeful that, you know, one day I will be rich.
sentences.zh: 我当时很穷，但我从不觉得自己穷，因为我充满希望，相信有一天我会富有。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: That's the beginning.
sentences.zh: 这就是开始。

sentences.en: And so what does he do with this newfound sense of freedom in this land where there's finally enough food?
sentences.zh: 那么，在这个终于有足够食物的土地上，他如何利用这种新获得的自由感呢？

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, he proves to be a very capable worker in this clothing factory.
sentences.zh: 他在那家服装厂证明了自己是一个非常有能力的人。

sentences.en: He works his way up the factory.
sentences.zh: 他在工厂里一路晋升。

sentences.en: I was not even 21.
sentences.zh: 我当时还不到21岁。

sentences.en: I was made a general manager of a factory of 300 people.
sentences.zh: 我就被任命为一家拥有300名员工的工厂的总经理。

sentences.en: And what did the factory make?
sentences.zh: 那家工厂生产什么？

sentences.en: The sweaters.
sentences.zh: 毛衣。

sentences.en: Then I start work and with luck, I was able to perform and make profit that they haven't made in a couple of years.
sentences.zh: 我开始工作，幸运的是，我表现出色，创造了他们几年都没能达到的利润。

sentences.en: One year he uses his bonus money to invest and buy his own factory.
sentences.zh: 一年后，他用奖金投资并买下了自己的工厂。

sentences.en: And so within a few years, he's running his own factory.
sentences.zh: 几年之内，他就经营起了自己的工厂。

sentences.en: That's very impressive for a man in his early 20s.
sentences.zh: 对于一个20出头的年轻人来说，这非常令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's quite impressive.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实非常令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: In many ways, it's a very Hong Kong story.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，这都是一个非常典型的香港故事。

sentences.en: It's an opportunity that he just would not have been afforded had he stayed in mainland China.
sentences.zh: 这对他来说是一个机会，如果他留在祖国大陆，是绝对不可能获得的。

sentences.en: So what happens to this factory that he buys?
sentences.zh: 那么他买下的这家工厂后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: It does well.
sentences.zh: 经营得很好。

sentences.en: I was working as a manufacturer for T-shirts.
sentences.zh: 我当时是做T恤衫生产的。

sentences.en: We're producing a lot for Polo, Ralph Lauren, and some other brand names.
sentences.zh: 我们为Polo、拉夫劳伦以及其他一些品牌代工生产。

sentences.en: And he eventually creates his own clothing company.
sentences.zh: 后来他创办了自己的服装公司。

sentences.en: When I was in New York, I was trying to name my retailing shop.
sentences.zh: 我在纽约的时候，正为我的零售店想名字。

sentences.en: He tells us this kind of wild story of how he came up with the name for his new company.
sentences.zh: 他给我们讲了一个关于他如何为新公司起名的离奇故事。

sentences.en: And one day I met somebody I knew in an importing company.
sentences.zh: 有一天，我在一家进出口公司遇到了一个熟人。

sentences.en: The guy gave me a few cookies.
sentences.zh: 那个人给了我几块饼干。

sentences.en: He's on a sales trip to New York, and he's unwittingly given a pot cookie.
sentences.zh: 他当时去纽约出差，无意中吃了一块含有大麻的饼干。

sentences.en: I was totally high.
sentences.zh: 我当时完全嗨了。

sentences.en: I didn't know that the cookie they put marijuana.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那饼干里加了大麻。

sentences.en: So I just felt so munchy.
sentences.zh: 我当时觉得特别饿，想吃东西。

sentences.en: And I went into a piece of paste.
sentences.zh: 我当时整个人都懵了。

sentences.en: He quenches his munchies with a bunch of pizza, and then later on finds a napkin in his pocket from this place, and it's called Giordano's.
sentences.zh: 他吃了一大堆披萨来解馋，后来在口袋里发现了一张来自那家店的餐巾纸，店名叫Giordano。

sentences.en: Giordano.
sentences.zh: 佐丹奴。

sentences.en: Wow, this is very good.
sentences.zh: 哇，这名字真不错。

sentences.en: Italian name.
sentences.zh: 意大利名字。

sentences.en: You know, I was stupid enough to think that if I used Italian name, people would think that the goods are from Italy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我当时傻到以为如果我用个意大利名字，人们就会觉得这些商品来自意大利。

sentences.en: He takes that name, thinking that it'll give this Hong Kong clothing company a sort of a European flair.
sentences.zh: 他采用了这个名字，认为这会给这家香港服装公司增添一种欧洲风情。

sentences.en: And Giordano becomes a success.
sentences.zh: 于是佐丹奴成功了。

sentences.en: And it sort of becomes the gap of Hong Kong and beyond Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 它在某种程度上成为了香港乃至香港以外地区的Gap。

sentences.en: They open up in China and other parts of Asia, and Jimmy Lai is on his way, becomes a multimillionaire.
sentences.zh: 他们在内地和亚洲其他地区开设了分店，黎智英的事业蒸蒸日上，成为了千万富翁。

sentences.en: So within a very short span, this child of mainland China, who used to carry the bags of rich men on their way to Hong Kong, is now himself a massive Hong Kong success story.
sentences.zh: 所以，在很短的时间内，这个曾经帮富人拎包去香港的内地孩子，如今自己也成了香港的一个巨大成功故事。

sentences.en: So how does it get from retail into media?
sentences.zh: 那么，他是如何从零售业转行到媒体业的呢？

sentences.en: So it starts with Chinese politics.
sentences.zh: 这要从中国政治说起。

sentences.en: This is, you know, the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 那是20世纪80年代。

sentences.en: There's a period of opening up in China.
sentences.zh: 中国正处于一个开放时期。

sentences.en: And people in mainland China begin pushing for even more.
sentences.zh: 内地民众开始争取更多的权利。

sentences.en: And so there's a protest movement in 1989 in Beijing and other large Chinese cities where students and workers come together and demonstrate and try and demand greater say in their government.
sentences.zh: 因此，1989年北京和其他中国大城市爆发了抗议运动，学生和工人聚集在一起游行示威，试图要求在政府中拥有更大的话语权。

sentences.en: And this is something that's followed very closely in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 而香港对此密切关注。

sentences.en: By this point, it's clear that Hong Kong will return to Chinese control.
sentences.zh: 到那时，香港回归中国已成定局。

sentences.en: And so people in Hong Kong are very invested in the idea of China becoming a democracy.
sentences.zh: 所以香港人非常关心中国实现民主的愿景。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Jimmy Lai, he has this belief that China will open up.
sentences.zh: 黎智英坚信中国会开放。

sentences.en: But that doesn't happen.
sentences.zh: 但事与愿违。

sentences.en: China sends in the troops.
sentences.zh: 中国派出了军队。

sentences.en: And on June 4th, 1989, Chinese soldiers kill hundreds, possibly thousands of demonstrators in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 1989年6月4日，中国士兵在北京杀害了数百甚至数千名示威者。

sentences.en: And that is the end of the protest movement.
sentences.zh: 抗议运动就此终结。

sentences.en: And how does Jimmy Lai react to the news of that massacre?
sentences.zh: 那么黎智英对那场大屠杀的消息有何反应？

sentences.en: He still believes that China will become a democracy.
sentences.zh: 他仍然相信中国会走向民主。

sentences.en: At that time when the Tiananmen massacre happened, I thought that the way for China to go forward, liberalization, was irreversible.
sentences.zh: 天安门大屠杀发生时，我以为中国前进的方向，即自由化，是不可逆转的。

sentences.en: I was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我错了。

sentences.en: I was a dreamer.
sentences.zh: 我曾是个梦想家。

sentences.en: I'm still a dreamer.
sentences.zh: 我现在依然是个梦想家。

sentences.en: And he wants to do what he can to push it in that direction.
sentences.zh: 他想尽自己所能推动中国朝着那个方向发展。

sentences.en: For somebody who has made enough money, I was 40 years old.
sentences.zh: 对于一个已经赚够了钱的人来说，我当时40岁。

sentences.en: You know, I made enough money for my life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我这辈子赚的钱已经够多了。

sentences.en: So, okay, let's go into the media.
sentences.zh: 所以，好吧，让我们进军媒体业吧。

sentences.en: Because I believe in the media by delivering information, you're actually delivering freedom.
sentences.zh: 因为我相信媒体通过传递信息，实际上就是在传递自由。

sentences.en: He sees the way of doing that is through the media.
sentences.zh: 他认为实现这一目标的途径就是通过媒体。

sentences.en: And so, as a child, when he saw food as freedom, now he sees information as freedom.
sentences.zh: 正如他小时候将食物视为自由，现在他将信息视为自由。

sentences.en: And by being a publisher himself, he can deliver that.
sentences.zh: 通过亲自担任出版人，他可以实现这一点。

sentences.en: So, his first publication is called Next Magazine.
sentences.zh: 所以，他的第一份出版物叫《壹周刊》。

sentences.en: Can you tell us about the philosophy of your publications?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们你的出版理念吗？

sentences.en: You described the inspiration to start them as the aftermath of Tiananmen and the crackdown and hopes to reform China.
sentences.zh: 你曾说创办它们的灵感来自于天安门事件及其后的镇压，以及对中国改革的希望。

sentences.en: And it's a very high-minded political idea.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常崇高的政治理想。

sentences.en: But Next Magazine and Apple Daily are famous for gossip.
sentences.zh: 但《壹周刊》和《苹果日报》却以八卦闻名。

sentences.en: So, it seems like there's a little bit of a contradiction there.
sentences.zh: 所以，这似乎有点矛盾。

sentences.en: What is the underlying?
sentences.zh: 其根本目的是什么？

sentences.en: The underlying is pro-freedom.
sentences.zh: 根本目的是追求自由。

sentences.en: And at the same time, I'm a retailer.
sentences.zh: 同时，我还是个零售商。

sentences.en: When I start Next Magazine, Magazine was like, okay, if you are a financial magazine, you're a financial magazine.
sentences.zh: 当我创办《壹周刊》时，当时的杂志界是这样的：如果你是财经杂志，你就是财经杂志。

sentences.en: If you're entertainment gossip, you're gossip.
sentences.zh: 如果你是娱乐八卦，你就是八卦。

sentences.en: So, I said, look, fuck it.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，去他的。

sentences.en: Why should I have to do this?
sentences.zh: 我为什么要那样做？

sentences.en: Why can't I put it all together and just choose the best of each one?
sentences.zh: 为什么我不能把它们整合在一起，只选择最好的内容呢？

sentences.en: And it became overnight, it says, my purpose is to sell and to deliver the message to as many people as possible.
sentences.zh: 它一夜之间就成功了，我的目的就是尽可能多地向人们销售和传递信息。

sentences.en: And we have been very persistent in our pro-democracy and freedom principle.
sentences.zh: 我们在支持民主和自由的原则上一直非常坚持。

sentences.en: And people in Hong Kong talk about, you know, in those days, like, waiting to get the next issue of Next Magazine.
sentences.zh: 当时香港人经常谈论等待《壹周刊》新一期的出版。

sentences.en: And five years later, he starts Apple Daily.
sentences.zh: 五年后，他创办了《苹果日报》。

sentences.en: Which is a daily newspaper.
sentences.zh: 那是一份日报。

sentences.en: And it's a very similar sort of mix of gossip and celebrity and also hard-hitting news and investigations and everything somebody might want to read, basically.
sentences.zh: 它融合了八卦、名人新闻，以及尖锐的调查报道，基本上涵盖了人们想读的一切。

sentences.en: So, how do these publications, Next, Apple Daily, how do they treat China?
sentences.zh: 那么，这些出版物，《壹周刊》和《苹果日报》，是如何对待中国的？

sentences.en: So, they're very critical of the Chinese Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 它们对中国共产党持非常严厉的批评态度。

sentences.en: In fact, Jimmy Lai gets into a lot of trouble over this.
sentences.zh: 事实上，黎智英因此惹上了大麻烦。

sentences.en: He has a column.
sentences.zh: 他有一个专栏。

sentences.en: And in this column, he insults Li Peng, who's the Chinese premier and person generally believed to have ordered the troops into Beijing.
sentences.zh: 在这个专栏里，他侮辱了李鹏，即中国总理，普遍认为是他下令军队进入北京的。

sentences.en: I don't know what year was that.
sentences.zh: 我不记得是哪一年了。

sentences.en: It's like maybe a couple years after the Tiananmen Square.
sentences.zh: 大概是天安门事件发生几年后吧。

sentences.en: He was saying something ridiculous, you know.
sentences.zh: 他说了一些荒谬的话。

sentences.en: So, I wrote a letter, called him the son of Turtle.
sentences.zh: 所以我写了一封信，称他为“王八蛋”。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He calls him a turtle's egg with zero IQ.
sentences.zh: 他称他为智商为零的“王八蛋”。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I don't know that reference very well, but I'm imagining that's a local insult that hurts.
sentences.zh: 我不太了解这个典故，但我猜这是一个伤人的本地骂法。

sentences.en: It's basically questioning both his intelligence and his parentage.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是在质疑他的智商和出身。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: Then China's sanctioned me and ordered me to sell the stick in Giordano within five days or whatever.
sentences.zh: 后来中国制裁了我，命令我在五天内卖掉佐丹奴的股份。

sentences.en: You know, otherwise they would close the shop in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，否则他们就会关闭北京的门店。

sentences.en: There's a very quick reaction from the Chinese authorities, and they begin closing Giordano shops in mainland China.
sentences.zh: 中国当局反应非常迅速，开始关闭中国内地的佐丹奴门店。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And he's forced to decide.
sentences.zh: 他被迫做出选择。

sentences.en: Does he want to run a media empire or a clothing empire?
sentences.zh: 他是想经营媒体帝国，还是服装帝国？

sentences.en: And he decides to stick with media.
sentences.zh: 他决定坚持做媒体。

sentences.en: And he sells all of his interest in Giordano for a few hundred million dollars.
sentences.zh: 他以几亿美元的价格卖掉了他在佐丹奴的所有股份。

sentences.en: And then he becomes strictly a media tycoon.
sentences.zh: 从此他成了一名纯粹的媒体大亨。

sentences.en: But I have to imagine that the message of that insult and the response from the Chinese government,
sentences.zh: 但我不得不认为，那个侮辱带来的信息以及中国政府的回应，

sentences.en: which is to directly punish him and hurt his business, is very clear to Jimmy Lai, which is if you mess with the Chinese Communist Party, there will be repercussions.
sentences.zh: 即直接惩罚他并损害他的生意，对黎智英来说非常明确：如果你招惹中国共产党，就会有后果。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And as China gets more powerful, the risks to Jimmy Lai get bigger.
sentences.zh: 随着中国变得越来越强大，黎智英面临的风险也越来越大。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序，第一个月免费。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: So Austin, how do these tensions start to play out once Jimmy Lai throws himself into this media empire?
sentences.zh: 那么奥斯汀，当黎智英投身于这个媒体帝国时，这些紧张局势是如何开始显现的？

sentences.en: And like you just said, China's power keeps growing.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才所说，中国的力量在不断增长。

sentences.en: Well, he becomes a very prominent and outspoken figure in the pro-democracy movement in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他成为了香港民主运动中非常突出和直言不讳的人物。

sentences.en: He participates in protests and his paper is a big backer of large protest movements in Hong Kong in 2014.
sentences.zh: 他参加抗议活动，他的报纸也是2014年香港大型抗议运动的重要支持者。

sentences.en: And also last year, he goes to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 去年，他还去了美国，

sentences.en: and meets with the Secretary of State to advocate for Hong Kong to become more democratic.
sentences.zh: 并会见了国务卿，呼吁香港实现更多民主。

sentences.en: And how risky is this behavior?
sentences.zh: 这种行为有多大风险？

sentences.en: Because it does seem very provocative, very publicly provocative.
sentences.zh: 因为这看起来确实非常挑衅，非常公开的挑衅。

sentences.en: Is there a sense that when you're a billionaire, you can do these kinds of things with a certain level of protection?
sentences.zh: 是否有一种感觉，当你成为亿万富翁时，你就可以在某种保护下做这些事情？

sentences.en: He's definitely taking risks.
sentences.zh: 他确实在冒险。

sentences.en: And he's arrested a few times for participation in illegal assemblies, for an incident with a photographer from a pro-Beijing newspaper.
sentences.zh: 他曾因参与非法集会以及与一家亲北京报纸摄影师的冲突而被捕过几次。

sentences.en: But the risks really escalate once the national security law comes into place.
sentences.zh: 但自从《国家安全法》实施以来，风险确实升级了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We've talked about this law with you on the show, Austin.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀，我们在节目中和你讨论过这部法律。

sentences.en: And it is written so broadly and so clearly in response to the protest movements of the past few years that it's pretty clear that the Chinese government and their allies in the Hong Kong government could pretty much find any reason to apply it to someone doing something they don't like.
sentences.zh: 它的条文写得非常宽泛，显然是为了应对过去几年的抗议运动，很明显，中国政府及其在香港政府的盟友几乎可以找到任何理由将其应用于任何他们不喜欢的人。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And nobody really knows how far it could go.
sentences.zh: 没人知道这会走多远。

sentences.en: So this national security law, I think, came as a big surprise.
sentences.zh: 所以这部《国家安全法》，我想，是一个巨大的意外。

sentences.en: What was your reaction when you first heard about this?
sentences.zh: 你第一次听说这个消息时是什么反应？

sentences.en: Oh, I couldn't believe it.
sentences.zh: 哦，我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: I thought it was rough.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这太粗暴了。

sentences.en: But the more I heard about it, the more it's true.
sentences.zh: 但听到的越多，就越觉得这是真的。

sentences.en: And I knew that that spelled the death knell of Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 我知道这意味着香港的丧钟敲响了。

sentences.en: Because the British government did not give us democracy, but it gave us rural, private poverty, freedom of speech, freedom of religion, freedom of assembly.
sentences.zh: 因为英国政府虽然没有给我们民主，但它给了我们法治、私有财产、言论自由、宗教自由、集会自由。

sentences.en: All this institution was the protection of freedom.
sentences.zh: 所有这些制度都是对自由的保护。

sentences.en: And that's why we Hong Kong people are so rebellious against CCP when the threat of our freedom was to be taken away.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么当我们的自由受到威胁时，我们香港人会如此反抗中共。

sentences.en: And for Jimmy Lai, the Chinese authorities and Chinese state media have really identified him as one of the main targets under this law.
sentences.zh: 对于黎智英来说，中国当局和中国官方媒体确实已将他列为该法案的主要目标之一。

sentences.en: And sure enough, within a few weeks after the law has passed, he's arrested.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，法律通过几周后，他就被捕了。

sentences.en: You're one of the first people in Hong Kong to be arrested under the national security law.
sentences.zh: 你是香港首批根据《国家安全法》被捕的人之一。

sentences.en: There's a new department within the police specifically to handle this.
sentences.zh: 警方内部有一个专门处理此事的部门。

sentences.en: So this is all very new.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都是全新的。

sentences.en: What was that like?
sentences.zh: 那是什么感觉？

sentences.en: It was like I was preparing for it.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像我一直在为此做准备。

sentences.en: And now the time has come.
sentences.zh: 现在时候到了。

sentences.en: I just take it easy.
sentences.zh: 我只是放轻松。

sentences.en: Because I don't know what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 因为我不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: And I just throw with it, throw with time, throw whatever.
sentences.zh: 我只是随遇而安，顺其自然。

sentences.en: But only worry that, you know, I ask my policeman, can I go back upstairs to say goodbye to my wife?
sentences.zh: 但我唯一担心的是，你知道，我问警察，我能回楼上和妻子告别吗？

sentences.en: Because she is the only thing that I worry.
sentences.zh: 因为她是我唯一担心的事。

sentences.en: She has to really suffer more than I do.
sentences.zh: 她确实比我承受了更多的苦难。

sentences.en: And that's the only thing I was concerned.
sentences.zh: 而那是我唯一关心的事情。

sentences.en: I was concerned.
sentences.zh: 我当时很担心。

sentences.en: He's escorted out of his mansion.
sentences.zh: 他被从豪宅中带走。

sentences.en: And then he's taken to the Apple Daily headquarters.
sentences.zh: 随后被带到了《苹果日报》总部。

sentences.en: And there's this just amazing scene of sort of a perp walk of Jimmy Lai through the newsroom.
sentences.zh: 当时新闻编辑室里出现了令人震惊的一幕，黎智英就像被游街示众一样。

sentences.en: And there are hundreds of police.
sentences.zh: 现场有数百名警察。

sentences.en: More than 200 police officers show up at the Apple Daily newsroom.
sentences.zh: 超过200名警察出现在《苹果日报》编辑室。

sentences.en: Reporters go there and they're live streaming the police raid on their headquarters.
sentences.zh: 记者们赶到现场，直播了警方对总部的突袭。

sentences.en: And editors are getting in arguments with police.
sentences.zh: 编辑们与警察发生了争执。

sentences.en: And it's a really dramatic scene.
sentences.zh: 那场面非常戏剧化。

sentences.en: And it's quite shocking to see so many police just descend on this newsroom.
sentences.zh: 看到这么多警察涌入新闻编辑室，确实令人震惊。

sentences.en: And so he, his two sons, and a few executives in his organization are arrested under national security violations.
sentences.zh: 于是他、他的两个儿子以及组织内的几位高管因违反国家安全法被捕。

sentences.en: But it's not made clear exactly what, in the few weeks since the law went into effect, he has done to violate this.
sentences.zh: 但在法律生效后的几周里，他究竟做了什么违反法律的事，并没有明确说明。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And how does he describe his time in jail?
sentences.zh: 他是如何描述狱中生活的？

sentences.en: He says that while he was being held, he thought about whether he would do things differently.
sentences.zh: 他说，在被拘留期间，他思考过自己是否会做出不同的选择。

sentences.en: Actually, I was thinking, if I knew that I would end up like this and in prison, would I have changed the way I run my life?
sentences.zh: 其实我在想，如果我知道自己最终会落得如此下场并身陷囹圄，我会改变我的人生轨迹吗？

sentences.en: And I realized that, no, I wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 我意识到，不会，我不会改变。

sentences.en: Because I never did anything before intentionally, just naturally.
sentences.zh: 因为我以前从未刻意去做什么，一切都是顺其自然。

sentences.en: So it must be my character.
sentences.zh: 所以这一定是我的性格使然。

sentences.en: You know, if he's my character, it's my destiny.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果这是我的性格，那这就是我的宿命。

sentences.en: So I was all relieved.
sentences.zh: 所以我感到释然了。

sentences.en: And I really don't have a liquid regret.
sentences.zh: 我真的没有任何遗憾。

sentences.en: And decides that at some point, he was going to have this collision with the authorities.
sentences.zh: 他认定在某个时刻，他注定会与当局发生冲突。

sentences.en: And he's satisfied with the things that he's done, that the choices he's made have led up to this point.
sentences.zh: 他对自己的所作所为感到满意，他所做的选择引领他走到了这一步。

sentences.en: Well, to that point, there's a line of thinking.
sentences.zh: 嗯，说到这一点，有一种观点。

sentences.en: And it's kind of a Chinese-centric line of thinking,
sentences.zh: 这是一种以中国为中心的观点，

sentences.en: but it's a line of thinking that the Communist Party hastened the imposition of this very strict security law because of all the protests and the attention that they garnered.
sentences.zh: 但这种观点认为，正是因为所有的抗议活动及其引发的关注，共产党才加速实施了这部严厉的国安法。

sentences.en: And to the degree that people like Jimmy Lai played a role in that movement, in supporting it, in amplifying it, criticizing China so openly,
sentences.zh: 如果像黎智英这样的人在运动中发挥了作用，支持它、扩大它，并如此公开地批评中国，

sentences.en: does he worry that he invited this law and its consequences faster than it might have happened if everybody, including Jimmy Lai, had acted differently?
sentences.zh: 他是否担心自己招致了这部法律及其后果，而如果包括黎智英在内的所有人采取不同的行动，这些后果本可能不会这么快发生？

sentences.en: Did he miscalculate the Chinese response?
sentences.zh: 他是否误判了中国的反应？

sentences.en: He does have criticisms of the movement.
sentences.zh: 他确实对这场运动有批评意见。

sentences.en: He argued for nonviolence.
sentences.zh: 他主张非暴力。

sentences.en: The violence and property destruction of the protests are things that he's critical of.
sentences.zh: 抗议活动中的暴力和破坏财产行为是他所批评的。

sentences.en: You know, when the kids first broke into the Legislative Council, I said, shit, this is too much.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当孩子们第一次冲进立法会时，我说，糟了，这太过分了。

sentences.en: When they first threw the fire bomb, I said, shit, this is going to be very detrimental to the movement.
sentences.zh: 当他们第一次投掷燃烧弹时，我说，糟了，这对运动非常不利。

sentences.en: And I was always telling those kids, we cannot be more violent than the CCP who has guns and tanks.
sentences.zh: 我总是告诉那些孩子，我们不能比拥有枪支和坦克的中共更暴力。

sentences.en: The only thing we have is moral authority.
sentences.zh: 我们唯一拥有的就是道德权威。

sentences.en: This is the only power we have.
sentences.zh: 这是我们唯一的力量。

sentences.en: But at the same time...
sentences.zh: 但与此同时……

sentences.en: But I can understand also why the kids are so violent, because they are so desperate.
sentences.zh: 但我也能理解孩子们为什么如此暴力，因为他们太绝望了。

sentences.en: They're at the beginning of their life.
sentences.zh: 他们的人生才刚刚开始。

sentences.en: I'm at the end of it.
sentences.zh: 而我已近暮年。

sentences.en: It's easy for me to say what I say.
sentences.zh: 我说这些话很容易。

sentences.en: But for them, if they don't fight, they will have the face of life without freedom.
sentences.zh: 但对他们来说，如果不抗争，他们面对的将是失去自由的一生。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: If the whole movement was more moderate, would the national security law come?
sentences.zh: 如果整个运动更温和一些，国安法还会来吗？

sentences.en: I think the national security law, kind of like this, will come eventually anyway.
sentences.zh: 我认为国安法迟早还是会来的。

sentences.en: But it just comes sooner.
sentences.zh: 只是来得早了一些。

sentences.en: He says that the Chinese government would have arrived at this point one way or another.
sentences.zh: 他说中国政府迟早会走到这一步。

sentences.en: That these sort of restrictions on Hong Kong were inevitable.
sentences.zh: 这种对香港的限制是不可避免的。

sentences.en: And according to that logic, what would be the point of tiptoeing around any of this?
sentences.zh: 按照这个逻辑，对这一切小心翼翼又有什么意义呢？

sentences.en: What would be the point of acquiescing or delaying?
sentences.zh: 默许或拖延又有什么意义呢？

sentences.en: It wouldn't gain much of anything.
sentences.zh: 那并不会带来什么好处。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, you know, he's not a subtle guy.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他不是一个圆滑的人。

sentences.en: In some ways, he probably relishes the conflict that comes with forcing the authorities' hand.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他可能很享受这种逼迫当局出手所带来的冲突。

sentences.en: I just believe that CCP definitely want to cram down on the rebellions of the Hong Kong people.
sentences.zh: 我只是相信中共绝对想镇压香港人民的反抗。

sentences.en: Because they don't understand why Hong Kong people are so rebellious.
sentences.zh: 因为他们不明白为什么香港人如此反叛。

sentences.en: They don't understand that we have a different value than those Chinese in China.
sentences.zh: 他们不明白我们与中国大陆的中国人有着不同的价值观。

sentences.en: And you and Tiffany were obviously talking to him in his home, not in a prison.
sentences.zh: 你和蒂芙尼显然是在他家里采访他，而不是在监狱里。

sentences.en: So how does he get out?
sentences.zh: 那么他是怎么出来的？

sentences.en: And so he's released on bail.
sentences.zh: 他被保释了。

sentences.en: You know, I didn't even think that they would allow me bail.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我甚至没想到他们会允许我保释。

sentences.en: There was a surprise.
sentences.zh: 这很令人惊讶。

sentences.en: You know, if they don't send me to China, at least they will keep me in custody until trial.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果他们不把我送回中国，至少他们会把我关押到审判为止。

sentences.en: But now, after paying $300,000 cash on bail and $200,000 personal guarantee, I'm not even charged.
sentences.zh: 但现在，在支付了30万现金保释金和20万个人担保后，我甚至还没有被起诉。

sentences.en: I don't know what my crime is.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我的罪名是什么。

sentences.en: There's not a day for me to be in court yet, although my passport was confiscated.
sentences.zh: 虽然我的护照被没收了，但我还没有收到出庭日期。

sentences.en: And that's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: He's not allowed to leave Hong Kong, so there is a lot of uncertainty in terms of his future and also the future of his publications.
sentences.zh: 他不被允许离开香港，所以他的未来以及他旗下刊物的未来都充满了不确定性。

sentences.en: You know, I'm struck, Austin, that Jimmy Lai's story, from the beginning, is, as you said, this quest for freedom.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀，让我印象深刻的是，黎智英的故事从一开始，正如你所说，就是一场对自由的追求。

sentences.en: And a quest for freedom that very much resembles Hong Kong's quest for freedom.
sentences.zh: 这场对自由的追求与香港对自由的追求非常相似。

sentences.en: The acquisition of it and then the loss of it.
sentences.zh: 从获得自由到失去自由。

sentences.en: And he has tasted that freedom.
sentences.zh: 他已经尝到了自由的滋味。

sentences.en: But at this point, if we're being honest, it kind of feels like that battle is now ending and that he is on the losing side of it.
sentences.zh: 但此时此刻，说实话，感觉那场战斗似乎正在结束，而他正处于失败的一方。

sentences.en: So does he see it that way?
sentences.zh: 那么他是这样看的吗？

sentences.en: I don't think he does.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他是这样看的。

sentences.en: I asked him about this because it struck me that now he was at a point in his life that was very similar to the experiences of protest leaders from 1989.
sentences.zh: 我问过他这个问题，因为我突然想到，他现在的人生阶段与1989年抗议领袖们的经历非常相似。

sentences.en: You know, from 89 and the Tiananmen experience, that often for political activists in China, there's a choice that's offered.
sentences.zh: 你知道，从89年和天安门的经历来看，对于中国的政治活动家来说，通常会面临一个选择。

sentences.en: You can go the path of Wang Dan and go to America.
sentences.zh: 你可以走王丹的路，去美国。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Some of those, like Wang Dan, spent some time in prison and then left and now live a life of freedom overseas.
sentences.zh: 像王丹那样的人，在监狱里待过一段时间，然后离开了，现在在海外过着自由的生活。

sentences.en: Or you can go the path of Liu Xiaobo and stay in China and end up in prison.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以走刘晓波的路，留在国内，最终入狱。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And some of those, like Liu Xiaobo, who's the Nobel Peace Prize laureate, spent time in prison and died in prison.
sentences.zh: 像诺贝尔和平奖得主刘晓波那样的人，在监狱里度过了时光，并死在狱中。

sentences.en: And so I asked Jimmy Lai, if a choice like that is...
sentences.zh: 所以我问黎智英，如果面临这样的选择……

sentences.en: I would choose the latter one.
sentences.zh: 我会选择后者。

sentences.en: You would go to prison?
sentences.zh: 你会选择坐牢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's the only way to end.
sentences.zh: 这是唯一的结局方式。

sentences.en: Because it's just making it very expensive for them if I stay.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我留下来，只会让他们付出非常昂贵的代价。

sentences.en: But it'd be very expensive for you, too.
sentences.zh: 但这对你来说代价也非常昂贵。

sentences.en: Huh?
sentences.zh: 嗯？

sentences.en: I mean, to spend the rest of, potentially the rest of your life in a prison cell, that's a great cost as well.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在监狱里度过余生，这代价也太大了。

sentences.en: For one person, as opposed to a country, that's a big, good bargain.
sentences.zh: 对于一个人来说，相对于一个国家，这笔交易很划算。

sentences.en: That's a very good bargain.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔非常划算的交易。

sentences.en: That's a very good bargain.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔非常划算的交易。

sentences.en: I mean, no, I choose to, I choose to bargains.
sentences.zh: 我是说，不，我选择，我选择这笔交易。

sentences.en: And he said that he would stay and fight and risk spending the rest of his life in a prison cell.
sentences.zh: 他说他会留下来抗争，冒着在监狱里度过余生的风险。

sentences.en: That's a bargain that he sounds like he's willing to make.
sentences.zh: 听起来他愿意接受这笔交易。

sentences.en: As somebody who's, you know, done very well for himself as an entrepreneur, that seems like a, that seems like a tough bargain to take.
sentences.zh: 作为一个作为企业家非常成功的人，这似乎是一个艰难的抉择。

sentences.en: It depends on what you want in life.
sentences.zh: 这取决于你想要什么样的人生。

sentences.en: If I was satisfied with being rich and a successful businessman, my life would be business.
sentences.zh: 如果我满足于做一个富有且成功的商人，我的人生就是生意。

sentences.en: That's not the kind of life I love I want.
sentences.zh: 那不是我所热爱和想要的生活。

sentences.en: I'm just lucky to have so much money.
sentences.zh: 我只是幸运地拥有这么多钱。

sentences.en: Not because I want to make it, you know.
sentences.zh: 不是因为我想赚它，你知道。

sentences.en: It's just very lucky.
sentences.zh: 这只是非常幸运。

sentences.en: I think that my true nature is a fighter.
sentences.zh: 我认为我的本性是一个斗士。

sentences.en: Mr. Lai, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 黎先生，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: As Tiffany and I are walking out, you know, I've interviewed Jimmy Lai a few times over the past 15 or so years.
sentences.zh: 当我和蒂芙尼走出来时，你知道，过去15年左右我采访过黎智英几次。

sentences.en: It occurs to me that this could potentially be the last time that I talk with him.
sentences.zh: 我突然想到，这可能是我最后一次和他交谈了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Austin.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，奥斯汀。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，美国。

sentences.en: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has sent a letter asking states and cities to prepare for the distribution of a possible coronavirus vaccine as early as late October or early November.
sentences.zh: 疾病控制与预防中心已发信要求各州和城市为最早在10月底或11月初分发可能的新冠疫苗做好准备。

sentences.en: Such a quick timetable is not at all certain,
sentences.zh: 如此紧迫的时间表一点也不确定，

sentences.en: but the letter has heightened concern among public health officials that the president is seeking to rush the distribution of a vaccine as part of his re-election strategy.
sentences.zh: 但该信件加剧了公共卫生官员的担忧，即总统正试图将疫苗分发作为其连任策略的一部分而仓促行事。

sentences.en: And in an unusual move,
sentences.zh: 而且在一个不同寻常的举动中，

sentences.en: the CDC is invoking emergency powers to bar landlords from evicting renters who are suffering financially because of the pandemic in order to curb the spread of the virus.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心正在援引紧急权力，禁止房东驱逐因疫情而陷入经济困境的租客，以遏制病毒传播。

sentences.en: The CDC said that evicted residents who may turn to friends, family, or shelters are at a greater risk of catching and spreading the disease.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心表示，被驱逐的居民可能会转向朋友、家人或收容所，这会增加感染和传播疾病的风险。

sentences.en: The eviction moratorium, which has upset landlords, will last through the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 这项令房东不满的驱逐禁令将持续到今年年底。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
